name: Grapes U-Pick
tagline: Ever After Farms U Pick Grape Vineyard
description: Grapes U-Pick grows Grapes in Altoona, FL. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Oct in this growing zone.
